title: Keep an unknown visible selection unresolved
purpose: Demonstrate that context cannot manufacture a Diderot concept for an unrelated selected word, and that the product exposes an explicit internet fallback while preserving telemetry evidence.
preconditions: The current slide contains the word presentation and also contains known concept controls such as PCA.
E2E evidence mode is enabled for the qualification run only.

activity.label: Render unresolved explanation and explicit fallback

messages.label: Select word presentation
messages.expected: Selection text is captured exactly as presentation.

messages.label: POST selection + local context
messages.expected: HTTP API receives the selected word as data with bounded context.

messages.label: Resolve selected element
messages.expected: status = unresolved; nearby PCA text must not create concept:pca.

messages.label: Return unresolved outcome
messages.expected: Panel shows Internet fallback and an explicit Search web action; no Diderot answer is fabricated.

messages.label: Emit unresolved semantic + explanation signals
messages.expected: semantic.id = unresolved, resolver.source = internet, transport = api, all correlated to root.

messages.label: OTLP traces / logs / metrics
messages.expected: GET root SpanId recovers the expected unresolved subtree and validator returns PASS.

steps.title: Select an unrelated visible word
steps.action: Select the word presentation from the visible mission title.
expected: The panel does not resolve PCA or another known concept from surrounding context.
The source label is Internet fallback.
The Search web action is visible and remains user-triggered.

steps.title: Verify the negative semantic API contract
steps.action: Call POST /api/semantic/v1/resolve with text presentation and context that also contains PCA.
expected: No context-only concept match is returned.

steps.title: Recover and verify unresolved runtime evidence
steps.action: Flush OTLP signals and query the evidence bundle by the Playwright root SpanId.
expected: The semantic.resolve span records presentation, status unresolved, source internet and transport api.
The explanation.render span remains correlated to semantic.id unresolved.
Expected logs and metric exemplars are correlated.
The executable telemetry contract verdict is PASS.
